name: SurplusGLOBAL
capabilities: Legacy semiconductor equipment sales and refurbishment
AI-powered marketplace for equipment and parts
summary: SurplusGLOBAL specializes in the sale, refurbishment, and remarketing of legacy semiconductor equipment and parts. They operate SemiMarket, an AI-driven global marketplace that facilitates efficient transactions and compliance management for semiconductor equipment and parts. Their expertise includes export control automation and demand-supply predictive matching technologies.
